about.title: Our story
about.lead: Rana Scent was created to bring the warmth of Kuwaiti hospitality into every space through fragrance.

sections.title: Hospitality, made present
sections.body: In Kuwait, fragrance greets a guest before words do. We design devices and refills that carry that welcome quietly through the majlis, the home and the car.

sections.title: Designed as objects
sections.body: Our diffusers are made to be seen as well as smelled: finished in gold, navy and charcoal, at home beside fine furniture.

sections.title: A library of families
sections.body: Oud, musk, floral, fresh and woody. Each family has its own character, so finding your signature is simple.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lead: Questions about a device, a refill or an order? We're here to help.
contact.name: Name

items.q: Can I order without an account?
items.a: Yes. Guest checkout will be available, and you can create an account later to track orders.

items.q: How do I choose a scent family?
items.a: Oud and woody feel warm and deep, musk is soft, floral is bright, and fresh is light and airy. The Discovery Trio is a good place to start.
